about_the_game:
You control someone lost within the labyrinth of their own mind. You don’t remember what happened… but something in this house remembers you.

This demo focuses on the beginning of the Sinister Remains story, letting you witness the character’s mental breakdown and the strange, unsettling events that unfold within the house.

Echoes in narrow corridors, objects moving on their own, and cassette recordings from the past… Each step brings you closer to the truth but also deeper into madness.

In this place where reality and hallucination intertwine, you can’t trust what you see or what you feel. Sometimes the voices will guide you, and sometimes they will deceive you. But remember the most terrifying secrets are often buried deep within your own mind.

With its dark atmosphere, detailed environment design, and ever-rising psychological tension, Sinister Remains: Demo offers the first step into an unforgettable horror experience.

content_descriptors.notes:
Content Warning
Sinister Remains contains disturbing and mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences. The game features strong psychological horror elements, an intense atmosphere, and story themes that may challenge the player’s mental well-being. It includes graphic depictions of blood, self-harm and suicide references, violent imagery, and portrayals of traumatic events.

As the narrative delves into dark pasts and psychological breakdowns of its characters, certain players may find the experience distressing. Viewer discretion is strongly advised before playing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 6000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Witness the story of a character on the edge of a mental breakdown, struggling to face their own memories. This demo offers a short but intense experience set at the beginning of Sinister Remains, revealing the first traces of the curse and the depths of a fractured mind.

English*, Spanish - Spain, Turkish
